items.title: FDA clears vessel-sealing device for Medtronic’s Hugo robot
items.summary: Widely adopted in open and laparoscopic surgeries, the LigaSure instrument is now available for use with the Hugo robotic system.

items.title: Should You Judge JNJ Stock Without STELARA?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) has been a rewarding stock to hold, up about 53% over the past year against about 17% for the S&P 500. The change worth noticing over that stretch is quieter than the price. Management said sales still rose 5.6% despite a STELARA drag of about 460 basis points. Management is encouraging investors to evaluate the company's underlying momentum by presenting growth rates that exclude STELARA alongside its reported figures.

items.title: Recor Medical ex-CEO Lara Barghout joins Medtronic
items.summary: Barghout, who led Recor when it won FDA approval of the first renal denervation treatment for hypertension, is the new president of Medtronic’s Interventional Cardiology Therapies business.

items.title: Has BSX Stock Finally Hit Bottom?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) stock has fallen about 57% over the past year, to about $45. The shares now sell for 3.2 times trailing sales, hovering near their decade-long historical trough of roughly 3.0 times and well off their 8.6 high.
